STATUS: fail

SUMMARY: The site holds up in headless Chrome on almost every criterion: structure, nav, the genre filter and its URL state, the events clock cases, form validation, 360px overflow, and contrast. One criterion fails: with JavaScript off, the contact form submits and reloads the page with the message in the URL. Probe scripts are in /tmp/claude-0/-tmp-ff-eval-2d3td8w8-workspace/b9762f2d-4333-419a-8568-a8a04d466a0b/scratchpad (p1–p4.mjs). The repo is unchanged (23 untracked entries before and after).

FILES TOUCHED: none (scratch copies under scratchpad/mut only)

FINDINGS:
- [blocking] Contact form with JS off navigates and reloads, and the message lands in the URL. Probe: `javaScriptEnabled:false`, click submit on visit.html → url `visit.html?name=&email=&subject=&message=`. Criterion 7 says submitting never navigates or reloads.
- [minor] Books page with JS off shows no books and an empty select (0 cards, 0 options). Criterion 4 doesn't require no-JS support, and README says JS is required, so this is a note, not a fail.
- [minor] FEATURE_FLOW.md is listed in FILES but is not in the repo.
- [minor] Inline links are 19–20px tall at 360px (footer phone, "See the whole catalogue", index event links). Criterion 8 only sets 44px for nav and filter controls, which pass (nav 44px, select 44px).
- [minor] Orchestrator's POETRY note is stale: `?genre=POETRY` and `?genre=%20poetry%20` now resolve to poetry (2 cards). Reproduced as a pass.
- [minor] Only a light scheme is defined; there is no dark palette to measure.

CHECKS:
- Structure, lang, title, viewport, one h1, landmarks, skip link first and moves focus to main, 4 pages → pass
- Origins: only 127.0.0.1 on every page; console errors and page errors on every page → none, pass

- Books URL cases (poetry, unknown-thing, empty, script tag, img onerror, POETRY, Poetry, padded, nature-writing, Nature writing, all, duplicate param) → pass, no console errors
- Books back/forward/forward sequence restores filter and select → pass

- Events clock: 2026-11-17, 2027-01-23 23:30 (today stays upcoming), 2027-01-24 00:30, 2027-05-22 23:59, 2027-05-23 00:00 (no-upcoming message shows), 2028, 2026-01-01 → all correct; Kiritimati zone run also correct
- Form: empty submit (4 errors, focus name, aria-invalid, aria-describedby); emails `a@`, `@b.com`, `a b@c.com`, whitespace, `a@b`, `a..b@c.com`, `a@b..com`, `.a@b.com` → all rejected with specific message and focus; error clears on correction; whitespace name/subject/message rejected; 10,000-char paste truncated to 2000 with counter; 2001 chars (maxlength removed) rejected; valid submit shows demo status and no navigation; double submit stable; enter-to-submit; 10,000-char name → pass
- Overflow at 360/768/1280 on all pages: scrollWidth equals viewport, nothing off-screen or clipped → pass

- Focus: every tab stop shows a 3px #0b5cad focus-visible outline; only non-visible stop is body wrap → pass
- Reduced motion: nav link transition 0s → pass
